people.name: Haroeh
people.line: Father of half the inhabitants of Manuhoth.

people.name: Kiriath-jearim
people.line: A city where the ark resided

people.name: Shobal
people.line: Son of Hur, founder of Kiriath-jearim, Judahite descendant.

translations.web: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim had sons: Haroeh, half of the Menuhoth.
translations.bsb: These were the descendants of Shobal the father of Kiriath-jearim: Haroeh, half the Manahathites,
translations.kjv: And Shobal the father of Kirjathjearim had sons; Haroeh, and half of the Manahethites.
translations.asv: And Shobal the father of Kiriath-jearim had sons: Haroeh, half of the Menuhoth.
